Demould/transport/lift and construction-stage controls
Finite mould/curing/crew/trailer/mixer/crane/site-buffer scenarios

Immutable QA event identities, idempotent replay, explicit retest/disposition and supersession consistency
Receipt-bound scenario comparison table with outstanding evidence and capacity sensitivities
remaining: Approved railway loads, ground and durability
Detailed reinforcement, anchors, joints and stair supporting structure
Qualified temporary works, lift plans, strength-development and actual crane/transport limits
Measured production/installation durations and authenticated complete-scope quotes
Final factory/transport/installed-system acceptance
Unified component/connection definitions across CAD, stage analysis, schedules and QA

workflow: Select fixed function and material/process bundle
Regenerate physical inventory, mass and physics
Confirm selected exact revisions in native CAD and scoped independent numerics
Veto failures and hold unavailable evidence
Nominate a new bounded capability only after separate benchmarks and exact-source review
